paper_title: Robust cosmological constraints on axion-like particles
notes: This is a theory paper deriving constraints on ALP mass and lifetime (m_φ, τ_φ) from reinterpreted cosmological data (BBN primordial abundances and Planck N_eff measurements). No new experimental measurements of specific coupling constants (g_aγγ, g_ae, etc.) are presented. The constraints are entirely theoretical models comparing cosmological observations to predicted ALP abundances. This does not meet the AxionLimitBench criterion for a new measured limit.
